subject: Linear trend line of a correlation/regression

messages.author: 9347048c9379e9a0
messages.subject: Linear trend line of a correlation/regression
parts:
Hi !

I wanted to know if there is any easy way that ggplot2 can draw a
linear trendline (with or without CI) on a scatter plot?

For example:
xvalues <- seq(0,10,by=1)
yvalues <- c(1,4,2,7,5,8,5,9,10,9,10)
d <- data.frame(xvalues,yvalues)
qplot(xvalues,yvalues)+geom_smooth()

but the smooth is not a linear (which in this case should be y=0.85x
+2,1)

Thanks!
shai

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: Linear trend line of a correlation/regression
parts:
qplot(xvalues,yvalues)+geom_smooth(method=lm)

The method argument gives you a few computational arguments that you can define. lm is just linear modeling. 

Brandon
